name: opennote
description: Local-first, open source note taking app inspired by the Evernote feature set.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test:wasm -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run pack -w desktop
